'''Northern Mustafarians''' were a subspecies of [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]], being one of two. Northern Mustafarians were taller and thinner than their [[Southern Mustafarian/Legends|southern counterparts]]. Both subspecies of Mustafarian evolved from extremophile arthropods that were living in caves in dormant volcanoes. Both species could resist the heat from common [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, but they both required armor to keep them safe near the lava flows of Mustafar.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
